info.name: Izigo API
info.description:
Rider + Driver + Admin API — Ride, Co-Ride, Package verticals.

Environment variables required:
- base_url: http://localhost:5000
- app_token: (set after login)
- admin_token: (set after admin login)
- otp_token: (set from OTP request response)

All money values are integers in minor units (XOF/NGN face value).
All timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.
